# Native capture: deleted application user-info boundary

A fresh 30-day Developer scratch org was created from a campaign Dev Hub. Three synthetic applications and a scratch-only permission set granting their visibility were deployed. A synthetic user was inserted with email notifications disabled; three UserAppInfo records referenced the apps. After deleting one synthetic app, all three saved lookup values remained populated and distinct when queried at API 62 and 67. Temporary app IDs are replaced with placeholders. No login or email occurred. This is a setup boundary, not an ordering result. The scratch org was deleted and ScratchOrgInfo status verified as Deleted. Earlier scratch attempts deployed apps without explicit visibility, found no matching visible definitions and were also deleted/verified.
